project: Machine Learning-Based Binary Classification of ARGs vs Non-ARGs

positive_dataset.model_type: Protein Homolog Model (canonical resistance genes; excludes single point mutation models)

negative_dataset.selection_criteria: Reviewed bacterial proteins (Swiss-Prot, taxonomy_id:2). Explicit exclusion of KW-0046 (Antibiotic resistance), KW-0089 (Beta-lactamase), GO:0046677, GO:0016999, GO:0042493, GO:0009249, and resistance terms in protein descriptions.
negative_dataset.query_string: reviewed:true AND taxonomy_id:2 NOT keyword:KW-0046 NOT keyword:KW-0089 NOT go:0046677 NOT go:0016999 NOT go:0042493 NOT go:0009249
